Kiboto

What each edition can do

Kiboto runs in three ways. This page says what each can do today, and what is still on its way.

Kiboto Companion beside another NAS systemThe container on Unraid, TrueNAS SCALE, Proxmox, FygoOS, UGOS or ZettOS. That system keeps running the drives and the machine.
Kiboto Companion on plain LinuxThe container on Debian, Ubuntu or any Docker host with no NAS system of its own.
Kiboto OSA machine of its own: Debian 13 set up by the Kiboto OS install image. Kiboto runs the drives and the machine. In beta.
